stem: 公私合作(PPP)在反金融犯罪工作中的主要优势包括:(选择两项.)

options.A: 提高识别和缓解金融犯罪风险的行动速度
options.B: 增强政府与金融机构之间的信息共享能力
options.C: 为金融机构在共享信息时免于承担责任提供法律框架
options.D: 消除组织自行开展尽职调查的需要

stem_en: The key strengths of public-private partnerships (PPPs) in anti-financial crime efforts include: (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Improving the speed of action in identifying and mitigating financial crime risks.
options_en.B: Enhancing information-sharing capabilities between governments and financial institutions.
options_en.C: Providing a legal framework for financial institutions to avoid liability when sharing information.
options_en.D: Eliminating the need for organizations to conduct their own due diligence.
